channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-63077 — JetBrains TeamCity
item.description: Threat Signal 91. JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

item.title: CVE-2026-81963 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

item.title: CVE-2026-85880 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2023-43770 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that can lead to information disclosure via malicious link references in plain/text messages.

item.title: CVE-2016-4656 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A memory corruption vulnerability in Apple iOS kernel allows attackers to execute code in a privileged context or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2016-6367 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A vulnerability in the command-line interface (CLI) parser of Cisco ASA software could allow an authenticated, local attacker to create a denial-of-service (DoS) condition or potentially execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-5002 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Adobe Flash Player have a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-1789 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A type confusion issue affecting multiple Apple products allows processing of maliciously crafted web content, leading to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-1364 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2016-4523 — Trihedral VTScada (formerly VTS)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. The WAP interface in Trihedral VTScada (formerly VTS) allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2022-23176 — WatchGuard Firebox and XTM
item.description: Threat Signal 61. WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances allow a remote attacker with unprivileged credentials to access the system with a privileged management session via exposed management access.

item.title: CVE-2017-0059 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Internet Explorer allow remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2016-0040 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. The kernel in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2020-1631 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A path traversal vulnerability in the HTTP/HTTPS service used by J-Web, Web Authentication, Dynamic-VPN (DVPN), Firewall Authentication Pass-Through with Web-Redirect, and Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-5223 — D-Link DSL-2760U
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the D-Link DSL-2760U gateway, allowing remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML.

item.title: CVE-2022-26485 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Mozilla Firefox contains a use-after-free vulnerability in XSLT parameter processing which can be exploited to perform arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-8218 — Pulse Secure Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A code injection vulnerability exists in Pulse Connect Secure that allows an attacker to crafted a URI to perform an arbitrary code execution via the admin web interface.

item.title: CVE-2022-20700 — Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2022-22620 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-22017 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Rhttproxy as used in vCenter Server contains a vulnerability due to improper implementation of URI normalization.

item.title: CVE-2021-30858 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-1871 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS WebKit contain an unspecified logic vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-37973 — Google Chromium Portals
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Google Chromium Portals contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects web browsers that utilize Chromium, including Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge.

item.title: CVE-2021-36948 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Windows Update Medic Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2018-8653 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to how the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-1380 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2019-19356 — Netis WF2419 Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

item.title: CVE-2019-16256 — SIMalliance Toolbox Browser
item.description: Threat Signal 61. SIMalliance Toolbox Browser contains an command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to retrieve location and IMEI information or execute a range of other attacks by modifying the attack message.

item.title: CVE-2020-4006 — VMware Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 61. VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-56155 — Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2008-4128 — Cisco IOS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Cisco IOS 12.4 contains multiple cross-site forgery vulnerabilities that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via (1) a certain "show privilege" command to the /level/15/exec/- URI, and (2) a certain "alias exec" command to the /level/15/exec/-/configure/http URI.

item.title: CVE-2026-11645 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-41091 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2023-36424 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could allow a threat actor for privileges escalation

item.title: CVE-2026-34621 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-31277 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple Safari, iOS, watchOS, visionOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow the processing of maliciously crafted web content which may lead to memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2026-3910 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 contains an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-3909 — Google Skia
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Skia contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

item.title: CVE-2022-20775 — Cisco SD-WAN
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Cisco SD-WAN CLI contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to gain elevated privileges via improper access controls on commands within the application CLI. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as the root user.

item.title: CVE-2026-25108 — Soliton Systems K.K FileZen
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Soliton Systems K.K FileZen contains an OS command injection vulnerability when an user logs-in to the affected product and sends a specially crafted HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2025-41244 — Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools contain a privilege defined with unsafe actions vulnerability. A malicious local actor with non-administrative privileges having access to a VM with VMware Tools installed and managed by Aria Operations with SDMP enabled may exploit this vulnerability to escalate privileges to root on the same VM.

item.title: CVE-2025-8876 — N-able N-Central
item.description: Threat Signal 60. N-able N-Central contains a command injection vulnerability via improper sanitization of user input.

item.title: CVE-2025-6558 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium contains an improper input validation vulnerability in ANGLE and GPU. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2025-6543 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability leading to unintended control flow and Denial of Service. NetScaler must be configured as Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

item.title: CVE-2025-5419 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2025-30397 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network via a specially crafted URL.

item.title: CVE-2024-49035 — Microsoft Partner Center
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Partner Center contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2025-24989 — Microsoft Power Pages
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Power Pages contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network potentially bypassing the user registration control.

item.title: CVE-2025-23209 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability caused by improper validation of the database backup path, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-44207 — Acclaim Systems USAHERDS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Acclaim Systems USAHERDS contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to achieve remote code execution on the system that runs the application. The MachineKey must be obtained via a separate vulnerability or other channel.
